| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |

That is only five rows. The second page's Mystery results show only two five-star titles, and I listed those two plus the three from page one, so the count of six is wrong: there are five.

I worked in my own tab (t2), which is still open on page 2 of the Mystery category. I left the other tab (t1) alone.

agents.answer:
I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin accepted it. The response page at https://httpbin.org/post echoed these values:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and extra cheese (the form's value for it is `cheese`)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** "Ring twice"

I set the time field with a script rather than typing into it. The form's data matched the order before I submitted.

Partway through, the browser's active tab switched to another agent's page (a books.toscrape.com tab). Some of my commands ran against that tab and failed, and nothing was filled in there. I switched back to my own tab, t1, and did all the filling and submitting there. I left t1 open on the response page.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

A="agent-browser --session task-726986e4d76a"; $A fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $A fill @e3 "555-0100"; $A fill @e4 "ada@example.com"; $A check @e7; $A check @e8; $A check @e9; $A fill "input[name=delivery]" "19:45"; $A fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $A eval "JSON.stringify([...new FormData(document.forms[0])])"

cd /tmp; A="agent-browser --session task-726986e4d76a"; $A tab t1 && $A fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace" && $A fill @e3 "555-0100" && $A fill @e4 "ada@example.com" && $A check @e7 && $A check @e8 && $A check @e9 && $A fill @e12 "Ring twice" && $A eval "document.querySelector('input[type=time]').value='19:45'; JSON.stringify([location.href,...new FormData(document.forms[0])])"

leakingCommands.command: agent-browser --session task-726986e4d76a tab; agent-browser --session task-726986e4d76a snapshot -i

The order is complete. The final page says "Checkout: Complete! Thank you for your order!"

I logged in as standard_user and sorted the products by price from low to high. I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart. I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001, and clicked Finish.

My first login attempt landed on a tab that wasn't mine, which another agent had pointed at books.toscrape.com. I opened my own tab (t3) and did everything there. That tab is still open on the confirmation page. I didn't open or close any other tabs.

I used the `agent-browser` CLI through the shell. I had no other browser tool.
